question: Q-W-S1-D4
text: Show FY2015 revenue by stock item Color as recorded at time of sale and by each item's current Color; list colors where the two differ.
interpretation: FY2015 revenue by stock item Color as recorded at time of sale (surrogate key, as-was) and by the item's current Color (durable key -> is_current row, as-is); differs = true where the two attributions disagree.
assemble: WITH w AS (SELECT color, revenue FROM as_was WHERE lines > 0), i AS (SELECT color, revenue FROM as_is WHERE lines > 0), colors AS (SELECT color FROM w UNION SELECT color FROM i) SELECT c.color, w.revenue AS revenue_as_was, i.revenue AS revenue_as_is, COALESCE(w.revenue, 0) <> COALESCE(i.revenue, 0) AS differs FROM colors c LEFT JOIN w ON w.color = c.color LEFT JOIN i ON i.color = c.color ORDER BY c.color
